title: VMR commercially relevant B2B geography base
source: Hand-curated for this product. Country names and the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 / alpha-3 code assignments are the published public standard identifiers; city names and their common alternate or former names are widely published general geographic knowledge. No third-party geographic database is vendored and no runtime geographic service is called.
license: The ISO 3166-1 code assignments used here are short factual identifiers, not a copyrightable compilation, and only the ~50 entries this product needs are included. City entries are plain place names. Nothing in this file is copied from a licensed gazetteer, and no coordinates, population figures, administrative hierarchies or rankings are asserted.
criteria: Countries were selected for commercial relevance to this product's B2B outbound work -- where the industries it researches concentrate buyers, suppliers, manufacturing and R&D -- with deliberate coverage across all nine regions below. This is NOT a claim that these are the world's fifty most important countries, and it is not a ranking. Cities are the principal commercial or industrial centres of each country, at least three per country and more where three would obviously misrepresent the country.
update_procedure: Adding or correcting entries is a NEW edition: bump `edition`, add the entries, and let seed_vocabularies publish and activate it. Editions are never edited in place, so geographies classified under an older edition keep resolving. See docs/COMPANY_INTELLIGENCE_TAXONOMY.md.
